description: No rate limiting: updates are opened as soon as they are found. The defaults (2 an hour, 10 at once) starve low-churn dependencies behind high-churn ones - gitea/act_runner sat four minor versions behind for months that way.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once the test workflow passes.
Major updates: open a PR but require manual review/merge.
supabase-swift git tags are v-prefixed, but SPM from: requirements in project.yml must be plain semver — xcodebuild crashes parsing 'v2.55.1'.

customManagers.description: SwiftLint and XcodeGen are downloaded from their GitHub releases in the workflow, so no built-in manager sees the pinned versions. Reads the `# renovate:` annotation above each env var, so a third pinned tool needs the annotation and nothing here.
